mZh: 蛇主财与情。梦见蛇缠身多为感情牵绊；青蛇入怀主得子或喜事；被蛇咬则需防小人暗算。
mEn: Snakes weave wealth and desire together — a coiling snake hints at a binding relationship, a snake entering your arms heralds blessing or new life, while a bite warns of hidden rivals.

mZh: 鱼主财。梦见活鱼跳跃主进财之喜；捕鱼得鱼主收获；鱼死或水浑则防破财。
mEn: Fish swim in fortune — leaping live fish foretell money luck, catching one marks a harvest, but dead fish or murky water caution against losses.

mZh: 梦见龙主贵气临身，事业升腾；乘龙升天为大吉之兆，贵人将至。
mEn: Dreaming of dragons heralds rising status and soaring ambition — riding one skyward is a supreme omen of noble help and elevation.

mZh: 虎主权威与阻碍并存。梦见骑虎主得势；被虎追则压力将至，需谨慎应对强势者。
mEn: Tigers mix power with peril — riding one means gaining authority, being chased warns of looming pressure from the mighty.

mZh: 猫主直觉与人际。梦见乖巧的猫主温情；猫抓咬需防身边人有所隐瞒。
mEn: Cats stir intuition — a gentle cat brings warmth, while scratches and bites hint someone close may not be fully honest.

mZh: 狗主忠诚与朋友。梦见狗咬陌生人主吉；被自家狗咬则防友情生变。
mEn: Dogs stand for loyalty — a dog guarding you augurs faithful allies, while your own dog biting hints at fraying friendship.

mZh: 鼠主耗。梦见老鼠成群防口舌是非与小破财；捉住老鼠则能化解烦恼。
mEn: Rats nibble at luck — swarming rats warn of gossip and small losses, but catching one means troubles resolved.

mZh: 鸟主消息与自由。梦见飞鸟主远方音信；笼中鸟醒得自由；鸟落肩头主喜讯。
mEn: Birds carry news and freedom — flying birds bring messages from afar, caged birds yearn for release, and one landing on you bears happy tidings.

mZh: 马主奔忙与机遇。梦见骏马奔腾主事业顺遂；骑马远行主贵人相助。
mEn: Horses gallop with opportunity — wild stallions signal smooth progress, riding afar means influential help on the road.

mZh: 牛主勤劳得财。梦见牛群主家业兴旺；被牛顶撞防固执误事。
mEn: Oxen plow steady wealth — herds foretell a thriving household, while being butted warns stubbornness may cost you.

mZh: 羊主温和之财。梦见羊群主平安顺遂；剪羊毛主进财。
mEn: Gentle flocks graze on calm fortune — sheep in numbers bring peace, shearing wool marks income on the way.

mZh: 鸡主家宅与信义。梦见公鸡报晓主吉信将至；鸡飞蛋打防落空。
mEn: Chickens rule home and honesty — a crowing rooster announces good news, while eggs shattering cautions plans may fall through.

mZh: 蜘蛛主机会缠身。蜘蛛结网主事情渐成；被蛛网缠住则防麻烦纠缠。
mEn: Spiders spin opportunity — a weaving web means matters maturing, but being trapped in one warns of entangling trouble.

mZh: 蝴蝶主情缘与蜕变。梦见蝶飞主姻缘变动或心境升华。
mEn: Butterflies flutter with romance and transformation — a dream of them signals love shifting or the soul rising.

mZh: 龟主寿与稳。梦见乌龟主健康长寿、固执守成得利。
mEn: Turtles carry longevity — dreaming of them promises lasting health and gains through patient steadiness.

mZh: 梦见父母笑容主家宅安宁；与父母争执则内心压力外化，宜多沟通。
mEn: Smiling parents mirror domestic peace; arguing with them reflects inner strain — reach out and talk.

mZh: 婴儿主新生与希望。抱婴儿主新的开始；婴儿啼哭则计划尚需呵护。
mEn: Babies embody beginnings — cradling one heralds a fresh start, while crying reminds that new plans need tender care.

mZh: 梦见死人主告别与重生，多为旧阶段结束；与死者交谈主心中未了之事。
mEn: Meeting the dead marks endings and rebirth — a chapter closing; conversation with them voices unfinished business.

mZh: 梦见自己结婚主责任与承诺降临；婚礼混乱则感情需重新审视。
mEn: Dreaming of your own wedding signals commitment arriving; a chaotic ceremony asks you to re-examine the bond.

mZh: 梦见与恋人争执主感情升温前兆（反向梦）；恋人离去则缺乏安全感。
mEn: Quarreling with a lover often reverses into growing closeness; a departing lover voices your unspoken insecurity.

mZh: 梦见朋友帮助主贵人运旺；与友反目则防现实中的误会积累。
mEn: Friends aiding you signal helpful people gathering; falling out with them warns misunderstandings may be piling up.

mZh: 陌生面孔主未知的自己。友善的陌生人主新机遇；可怖的陌生人主内心不安。
mEn: Strangers mirror your unknown self — a kind one bears fresh opportunity, a frightening one voices inner unease.

mZh: 梦见医生主健康提示或困境将有人相助。
mEn: Doctors in dreams call attention to health — or promise help arriving for your troubles.

mZh: 梦见帝王主抱负觉醒，渴望掌控自己的人生。
mEn: Meeting an emperor awakens ambition — a longing to command your own destiny.

mZh: 水主财与情绪。清澈之水主财运顺遂；大水泛滥主情绪或债务压力；溺水提醒量力而行。
mEn: Water flows with wealth and emotion — clear water favors fortune, floodwaters swell stress or debt, and drowning warns to know your limits.

mZh: 火主名与怒。炉火主家运兴旺；大火烧宅主情绪失衡；火中自救主化解危机。
mEn: Fire blazes with fame and temper — a hearth warms the household, a house ablaze flags burning emotions, escaping flames means crisis resolved.

mZh: 细雨主润泽与新生；暴雨主情绪宣泄；雨后彩虹主苦尽甘来。
mEn: Soft rain nourishes fresh starts; storms drain pent emotion; the rainbow after promises hardship rewarded.

mZh: 雪主纯净与冷静。梦见落雪主心境沉淀；雪中行走主孤独但清醒。
mEn: Snow purifies and quiets — falling snow settles the mind, walking through it marks lonely but lucid times.

mZh: 雷电主突变与觉醒。梦见雷而不惊主逢凶化吉。
mEn: Thunder cracks sudden change — unshaken by it, you turn misfortune to fortune.

mZh: 山主依靠与目标。登山顶主愿望达成；山崩防根基动摇。
mEn: Mountains anchor ambition — summiting one fulfills wishes, while a landslide warns foundations may shake.

mZh: 月主圆满与阴晴。满月主姻缘圆满；残月主等待时机。
mEn: The moon waxes with romance — a full moon completes love, a crescent counsels patient timing.

mZh: 日出主运势上扬、真相大白；烈日当空主名望正盛。
mEn: Sunrise lifts fortune and reveals truth; the blazing noon sun marks reputation at its height.

mZh: 满天星斗主愿望众多且有望实现；流星主转瞬即逝的机会。
mEn: Starry skies brim with wishes within reach; a shooting star marks a chance that flashes by — catch it.

mZh: 微风主变化温和到来；狂风主生活节奏被打乱。
mEn: A soft breeze brings gentle change; gales scatter your routines — brace and re-order.

mZh: 大海主胸怀与未知。平静的海主心绪开阔；巨浪主机遇与风险同来。
mEn: The sea stretches with the unknown — calm waters open the heart, great waves carry opportunity and risk in the same swell.

mZh: 房子主自我根基。老宅主怀念与旧事；新房主新阶段；房屋破损则需修补内在。
mEn: Houses frame the self — an old home calls back the past, a new one opens a chapter, cracks ask for inner repair.

mZh: 梦见回到考场主现实面临考验、担心准备不足。
mEn: Back in the exam hall — life is testing you, and you fear being unprepared.

mZh: 迷路主方向感缺失。梦见找不到路宜暂停规划、重新定标。
mEn: Losing your way mirrors lost direction — pause, re-plan, reset the compass.

mZh: 医院主修复。梦见自己住院主需要休整；探病主关心之事待解。
mEn: Hospitals mean repair — being admitted asks for rest, visiting flags a concern awaiting resolution.

mZh: 坟墓主尘封与终结。梦见坟墓未必凶，多为旧念归葬、心境沉淀。
mEn: Graves seal and settle — seldom ominous, they bury old obsessions and calm the heart.

mZh: 桥主过渡。过桥顺利主阶段转换成功；桥断则宜放缓计划。
mEn: Bridges span transitions — crossing smoothly blesses the next stage; a broken one says slow down.

mZh: 电梯主起伏。上升主地位提升；急坠主失控感，宜稳住核心事务。
mEn: Elevators ride your rise and fall — ascending lifts your standing, plunging voices lost control: steady the core.

mZh: 飞翔主自由与突破。飞得高远主事业跃升；飞不动则现实束缚较多。
mEn: Flying frees the soul — soaring high marks a career leap; wings that fail reflect real-world constraints.

mZh: 掉牙主转变与忧虑。传统解为家中长辈安康需留意，或自身形象与言辞之虑。
mEn: Teeth falling out marks transition and worry — traditionally watch elders' health, or mind your image and words.

mZh: 被追赶主逃避压力。梦里逃得越急，现实越需直面问题根源。
mEn: Being chased means dodging pressure — the harder you flee in the dream, the more reality asks you to face it.

mZh: 坠落主失控与不安。宜检查财务、健康与人际中的风险点。
mEn: Falling signals lost control — audit the risk points in money, health and relationships.

mZh: 游泳主驾驭情绪。姿势从容主掌控得宜；呛水则防情绪失控。
mEn: Swimming tames emotion — easy strokes show control; choking water warns of feeling overwhelmed.

mZh: 迟到主焦虑错过机会。宜重新排序生活中的优先级。
mEn: Running late voices fear of missed chances — re-rank your priorities.

mZh: 生产主成果诞生。创业者、学生做此梦多主项目或学业将出成绩。
mEn: Giving birth heralds creation — founders and students alike often dream this before results arrive.

mZh: 剪发主去旧。主动剪发主决心改变；被剪则防被动失财。
mEn: Cutting hair sheds the old — choosing to cut shows resolve to change; forced cuts warn of unwilling losses.

mZh: 梦中痛哭主情绪释放，醒后反而轻松，多为吉兆。
mEn: Weeping in dreams releases what waking life holds in — you often wake lighter; it bodes well.

mZh: 开车主掌控人生方向。车况好主顺遂；刹车失灵主节奏过快需减速。
mEn: Driving steers your life — a smooth ride blesses the path; failed brakes say life's moving too fast, ease off.

mZh: 梦见拾金主机会，但传统提醒防小人与虚名；数钱主计划清晰。
mEn: Found cash hints at opportunity — yet tradition cautions against flattery and hollow gains; counting money shows plans in focus.

mZh: 黄金主价值与贪欲。得金主认可将至；埋金主藏才待时。
mEn: Gold gleams with worth and want — receiving it means recognition nearing; burying it hides talent awaiting its hour.

mZh: 钥匙主解法与门路。找到钥匙主难题将解；钥匙断裂宜换思路。
mEn: Keys unlock answers — finding one means solutions near; a snapped key says try another way in.

mZh: 镜子主自省。镜中清晰主自知之明；镜裂主自我形象需重建。
mEn: Mirrors reflect the self — a clear one shows self-knowledge; a cracked one asks for a rebuilt self-image.

mZh: 钟表主时间压力。表停主该停一停；表快主焦虑催促。
mEn: Clocks tick with pressure — a stopped watch calls for rest, a racing one mirrors anxious hurry.

mZh: 家宅起火主变动剧烈，多为旧生活模式将被打破，宜主动求变。
mEn: A burning house shakes foundations — old patterns breaking up; better to change on your own terms.

mZh: 蛇缠身主情感或债务的羁绊，理清关系即可脱困。
mEn: A coiling snake binds you with feelings or debts — untangle the ties to break free.

mZh: 鱼跃主财机显现，宜把握眼前的突出机会。
mEn: A leaping fish flashes fortune surfacing — seize the standout chance before you.

mZh: 书信主音信。收信主远方消息；寄信主有话想对人说。
mEn: Letters carry tidings — receiving one brings distant news; sending one voices things you long to say.

mZh: 照片主回忆与形象。翻看旧照主怀念过去；照片模糊主身份迷茫。
mEn: Photographs fix memory — leafing through old ones longs for the past; a blurry image mirrors identity confusion.

mZh: 收礼主人缘与馈赠将至；送礼主想修补或加深关系。
mEn: Gifts flow with goodwill — receiving one heralds kindness coming; giving one seeks to mend or deepen a bond.

mZh: 通讯工具损坏主担心失去联系、社交焦虑。
mEn: A broken phone voices fear of losing touch — social anxiety ringing.

mZh: 红月主情绪波动剧烈，宜静养心神，勿在冲动时做决定。
mEn: A blood moon stirs emotional tides — rest the heart, and never decide in the heat of it.

mZh: 蜕皮主新生，告别旧阶段后运势将焕然一新。
mEn: Shedding skin means rebirth — once the old phase ends, fortune renews itself.

mZh: 棺材谐音'官财'，传统主升官发财，亦象征旧我封存。
mEn: The coffin puns on 'office and riches' — traditionally a promotion omen, and the old self laid to rest.

mZh: 梦见入庙拜神主内心寻求指引，贵人指点将至。
mEn: Entering a temple voices a search for guidance — wise counsel is on the way.

mZh: 淋雨主无备而受挫，宜提前为工作生活做预案。
mEn: Caught in the rain unsheltered — setbacks find the unprepared; build a fallback first.

mZh: 梦见名人主渴望被认可，也是自我期许的投射。
mEn: Meeting a celebrity reflects hunger for recognition — your own aspirations projected.

mZh: 梦见前任主未完的情绪而非复合预兆，宜放下向前。
mEn: Dreaming of an ex stirs unfinished feelings, not reunion signs — release and move forward.

mZh: 地震主根基震动，事业或家庭将现变动，宜未雨绸缪。
mEn: Quakes shake foundations — changes stir work or home; prepare before the ground shifts.

mZh: 洪水主情绪与压力泛滥，宜疏不宜堵。
mEn: Floods overflow with emotion and pressure — channel them, don't dam them.

mZh: 森林主潜意识的迷宫。走出森林主理清思绪；迷失其中主思虑过多。
mEn: Forests maze the subconscious — walking out clears the mind; wandering lost marks overthinking.

mZh: 沙漠主资源匮乏感，提醒补充能量、休整再出发。
mEn: Deserts feel resource-poor — a reminder to replenish yourself before pressing on.

mZh: 瀑布主情感奔涌与洗炼，压力将一泻而下。
mEn: Waterfalls surge with released feeling — pressure is about to pour away.

mZh: 彩虹主苦尽甘来，愿望将获回应。
mEn: Rainbows crown endurance — wishes answered after the storm.

mZh: 白云主心境舒展；乌云主短期阴霾，终将散去。
mEn: White clouds ease the mind; dark ones pass in time — a brief haze, no more.

mZh: 火车主既定轨道的机会。赶上火车主时机正好；错过主需另择路径。
mEn: Trains run on fixed tracks — catching one means timing is right; missing one says take another route.

mZh: 乘飞机主目标高远。起飞主计划启动；迫降主临时变数。
mEn: Airplanes aim high — takeoff launches the plan; an emergency landing brings sudden detours.

mZh: 船主渡运与机遇。顺流主贵人送行；逆风主需再坚持。
mEn: Boats ferry opportunity — a fair current brings helpers; headwinds ask for more persistence.

mZh: 自行车主靠自己的努力前行，节奏由己。
mEn: Bicycles move by your own pedaling — progress at a pace you set.

mZh: 鞋子主位置与方向。新鞋主新岗位；丢鞋主角色变动不安。
mEn: Shoes carry your place and path — new ones step into new roles; losing them unsettles where you stand.

mZh: 衣服主外在形象。换新衣主新身份；衣不蔽体主怕暴露短板。
mEn: Clothes dress your image — new garments mean new identity; torn ones fear exposed weak spots.

mZh: 丢钱包主对财务或价值感的焦虑，宜整理收支。
mEn: A lost wallet aches over money and self-worth — time to tidy the accounts.

mZh: 眼镜主看清真相。戴上主获得洞察；碎裂主误解将生。
mEn: Glasses clarify truth — putting them on gains insight; cracked ones herald misunderstanding.

mZh: 蜡烛主希望与坚持。烛光不灭主信念长存。
mEn: Candles hold hope and persistence — a flame that won't die is faith that won't either.

mZh: 书本主知识与机会。翻书主学习运旺；无字之书主方向未明。
mEn: Books bind knowledge and chance — turning pages favors study; blank pages mean direction still unclear.

mZh: 宴席主人际滋润。与人共餐主合作愉快；独自进食主需要陪伴。
mEn: Feasts feed connection — sharing a table favors cooperation; eating alone longs for company.

mZh: 婴儿车主计划将落地实施，需持续照看。
mEn: A baby carriage wheels plans into motion — they still need watching.

mZh: 花开主喜事近；花谢主盛极而衰，宜惜福。
mEn: Blooming flowers usher joy; petals falling remind fortune peaks fade — cherish it.

mZh: 大树主庇护与根基。枝繁叶茂主家运昌隆；枯木逢春主转机。
mEn: Trees root and shelter — lush leaves bless the household; a dead tree budding marks the turn.

mZh: 蚂蚁主积少成多。梦见蚁群主靠勤奋积累将有所成。
mEn: Ants gather bit by bit — a marching column promises rewards earned by diligence.

mZh: 蜜蜂主甜蜜与忙碌并至，付出将有回报。
mEn: Bees bring sweetness through busyness — effort will pay in honey.

mZh: 鸡鸣主新周期开始，提醒把握清晨般的时机。
mEn: The rooster's crow opens a new cycle — seize the dawn-bright moment.

mZh: 捕鱼主把握财运，徒手抓鱼主凭本事进账。
mEn: Catching fish grasps fortune — bare-handed catches mean earnings by your own skill.

mZh: 登山主攀登事业。登顶主目标达成；中途歇脚主节奏合理。
mEn: Climbing mirrors career — the summit fulfills the goal; resting midway is wisdom, not weakness.

mZh: 搬家主环境与心境转变，宜顺势更新生活安排。
mEn: Moving house marks shifting scenes and moods — refresh your arrangements with it.

mZh: 沐浴主洗去霉运与烦恼，身心将得更新。
mEn: Bathing washes off ill luck and worry — body and mind soon renewed.

mZh: 梦见考得极好主近期努力将被认可，信心可乘势而上。
mEn: Acing the exam foretells effort about to be recognized — ride the rising confidence.

mZh: 做饭主经营生活。手艺得赞主付出被看见。
mEn: Cooking tends life's hearth — praise for the dish means your effort is seen.

mZh: 通话主沟通渴望。拨不通主有话难言；接通主误会将解。
mEn: Calls crave connection — a number that won't connect holds unspoken words; getting through mends a misunderstanding.

mZh: 奔跑主目标推进。轻快主进展顺利；气喘主负荷过重。
mEn: Running pushes the goal — a light stride means smooth progress; gasping breath says the load's too heavy.

mZh: 跳舞主生活节奏和谐，人际关系将更融洽。
mEn: Dancing tunes life's rhythm — relationships will move more smoothly.

mZh: 垂钓主耐心等待收获，心急不得。
mEn: Fishing rewards patience — the bite comes to those who wait calmly.

mZh: 唱歌主表达欲升腾，好消息可与人分享。
mEn: Singing lifts the urge to express — good news wants sharing.

mZh: 撑伞主有备而来，困难前已有安排。
mEn: An umbrella overhead means you came prepared — shelter already arranged before trouble.

mZh: 敬老赠礼主得长辈庇佑，家运和顺。
mEn: Honoring elders with gifts draws their blessing — the household runs in harmony.

mZh: 品茶主心境从容，繁琐事将化简。
mEn: Sipping tea settles the mind — complications will simplify.

mZh: 动物开口主潜意识提醒，梦里的话值得细想。
mEn: Animals that speak carry the subconscious's memo — the words in the dream deserve a second thought.

mZh: 重返童年主怀念纯真或压力怀旧，宜照顾内心的小孩。
mEn: Returning to childhood longs for simpler days — be kind to your inner child.

mZh: 暗室主未知与压抑。开灯主寻求答案的意愿强烈。
mEn: A dark room holds the unknown and the suppressed — reaching for the light shows you're ready for answers.

mZh: 登高主眼界提升；高处不胜寒主地位提升伴随孤独感。
mEn: Climbing high widens the view — yet the summit can be lonely as status rises.
